dct_title_s: Vue de la Baye de False; Vue de la Rade de Simons-Baye
dct_description_sm: Five silhouettes (Cape Agulhas, Cape of Hottentots, Cape of Good Hope, and two views of False Bay) on one sheet. Top right: 8.2d.
